name: Email a weekly overview of your bookings via Carly with Gmail

parameters.content:
## Email a weekly overview of your bookings via Carly with Gmail

**Who's it for**
Anyone using [Carly](https://www.usecarly.com) booking pages who wants a Monday-morning summary of the week's bookings in their inbox.

**How it works**
Every Monday at 8am:
1. Lists all bookings via Carly whose start time falls in the next 7 days
2. Splits them into one item per booking
3. Builds an HTML table (when, event, who, status), sorted by start time
4. Emails the digest to you via Gmail

**How to set up**
1. Install the `n8n-nodes-carly` community node.
2. Add your Carly API credential (API key from your dashboard at https://www.usecarly.com).
3. Connect Gmail.
4. Set your email address in the **Settings** node.
5. Activate the workflow.

**Requirements** — self-hosted n8n, a Carly account + API key, a Gmail account.

**Customize** — change the send day/time on the trigger; adjust the table in the Build digest node.

Learn more about Carly: https://www.usecarly.com

Uses a community node — **self-hosted n8n only**.

## 1. Configure
Set the email address to send the weekly overview to.

## 2. Pull this week's bookings
List bookings in the next 7 days and split into individual items.

## 3. Build & email the digest
Format an HTML table and send it via Gmail to the address from Settings.
